smoke_examples.notes: Simple open-right state with key elsewhere and a closed door elsewhere.
Immediate east cell is a wall.
Moving RIGHT picks up the key immediately.
Open door is already visible in the manual smoke state.
Wall to the east, but an open door is visible elsewhere.
The goal is immediately to the east, which should often elicit RIGHT.
Open door immediately to the east remains open after moving RIGHT.
Carrying the key does not imply the closed door is already open.
No door in the state; RIGHT is blocked only by a wall.
Open door is visible elsewhere; moving RIGHT leaves that status unchanged.

#: Wall
_: Open Space
G: Goal
A: Current agent position

0 # # # # # # # # #

4 # _ _ _ G _ _ _ #
5 # _ _ _ _ _ _ _ #
6 # _ _ _ _ _ _ _ #
7 # _ _ _ _ _ _ _ #
8 # # # # # # # # #
